the most critical ERP implementation challenges are: lack of top management support and sponsorship, lack of user involvement, lack of project management, lack of business process reengineering, lack of change management and communication, lack of organizational readiness, lack of project planning and lack of training and education.

ERP implementation failures occur because of: lack of user involvement, lack of top management support, poor communication and training, poor project planning and management, and poor system selection.
